blocks.text: Around 150 nursing educators, hospital leaders, healthcare professionals, and industry stakeholders representing more than 40 institutions gathered recently at Patio Victoria in Intramuros, Manila to examine how simulation-based learning can help better prepare Filipino nurses for the realities of clinical practice. Organized by the Healthcare Simulation Society of the Philippines (HSSP) in partnership with HCT Academy, the symposium, “Shaping the Future of Philippine Nursing Education through Simulation,” brought together local healthcare and academic leaders with international experts in nursing education, clinical simulation, critical care, and faculty development.
